fingerprintScheme.blobDomain: restricted-git-blob-v1 followed by one NUL byte
fingerprintScheme.commitDomain: restricted-git-commit-v1 followed by one NUL byte
fingerprintScheme.formula: SHA256(domain + normalized full Git SHA-1), lowercase hexadecimal
fingerprintScheme.limitation: Comparison keys avoid direct Git locators. They are not secrecy, rights clearance or evidence of remote deletion.
fingerprintScheme.normalization: Strip ASCII space, tab, CR and LF; lowercase; require exactly 40 ASCII hexadecimal SHA-1 digits.

metadataMigration.method: One bounded snapshot rebuild from unchanged pinned main, then a normal commit pinning the clean snapshot; explicit expected-head force-with-lease.
metadataMigration.reason: Both prior PR commit trees still published direct restricted-object locators; a deletion commit alone would leave those locators reachable.

permissionPolicy: No explicit full redistribution grant was established in the retained records. Conservatively exclude every full response/extraction from this PR ancestry, including rejected responses.

residualRisk.followUp: Repository owner may ask GitHub Support to assess retired commits, full-response blobs, historical locator manifests, PR refs and caches. Exact locators remain only in the local untracked owner packet. No request has been sent; cleanup availability is not guaranteed.
residualRisk.notClaimed: Branch history reconstruction does not guarantee GitHub object, PR timeline or cache deletion.
